.skill-tree/common/references/director-w: Freeze equivalent briefs, accepted facts, available inputs, controls, and exact ordinary and revised instruction revisions. Ask two independent reviewers to reconstruct expected and consumed revisions, coverage, earliest evidenced divergence and next owner. Record reviewer disagreement and unavailable evidence. An unavailable decisive input leaves causal attribution open. Record the missing evidence and the responsible owner.

Check changed intent, effective configuration, available artifacts and author waits before assigning a recurring problem to a skill. A skill finding requires reproduction under a known instruction revision and an independently established outcome. Record adopt, revise or defer for the selected scope with residual uncertainty. Recheck the original case, an unaffected negative control and a comparable new request after an authorized fix.
.skill-tree/common/references/history-re: Retain comparable handoff IDs, both instruction revisions, the discriminating evidence and controls, observed disagreements, and the scoped disposition. An unresolved source gap stays visible with the responsible owner. Keep the original failed or incomplete observation under the original revision when a later authorized fix produces a new attempt.
